title: Towards Machine-Learning Enabled Automated Analysis of Heterogeneous Nanomaterials
content: Automation is playing an increasingly important role in the discovery, design, and synthesis of materials. In the field of nanomaterials, high-throughput robotic solution phase and thin film synthesis are increasingly adopted to optimize nanomaterial properties and explore design spaces [1, 2]. Similarly, many experimental characterization methods are increasingly automated, often with the goal of combing these measurements with robotic synthesis tools to perform closed-loop synthesis.
